trust_center.repositoryDescription: Fulcrum's FedRAMP certification data: a program overview, and Fulcrum's published positions on the FedRAMP rules and Key Security Indicators that apply to the offering.
trust_center.accessRequestInstructions: Go to https://trust.fulcrumpro.us and choose "Government agencies and assessors". Enter your work email address and sign in with the one-time passcode sent to it. Some organizations are given access when their members first sign in. For any other address, the sign-in is recorded as a request for access: Fulcrum responds to requests from government addresses within 5 business days, and contacts other requesters about their request. Fulcrum staff choose "Fulcrum staff".

secure_configuration_guidance.repositoryDescription: The Secure Configuration Guide for the offering: what each security setting does, the recommended configuration against the shipped one, and how to access, operate and decommission administrative accounts. It is generated from the same source as the Trust Center's edition, which adds citations for assessors and the recommended settings in machine-readable form. To use it, a tenant administrator follows each row's recommendation in the guide's table of recommended settings. Not every row is a value to set: some depend on whether the tenant has shared devices, one says which two settings not to turn on together, and some ask for an audit of who holds a role or permission. To check a tenant against it, export the tenant's security settings from the Fulcrum API, as the guide describes, and compare the export with the recommendations on the Trust Center, which gives a verdict for each recommended setting.

certified_services.serviceDescription: The AI built into Fulcrum. It answers questions about live shop data, takes actions on it, and builds custom pages and tools.
The Fulcrum MCP server, which connects a customer's own AI assistant to Archie's data tools within the user's permissions, and the Fulcrum REST API.
Quality management for AS9100D and ISO 9001 shops: drawing bubbling, in-process inspection, nonconformances, corrective actions and calibration.
Nests generated from DXF files on quotes, nest planning across orders, and grouping of operations across jobs into shared work.
Quotes with material and labor pricing and capacity-based lead times, converted into sales orders.
Multi-level bills of materials and operation routings for every made part.
Material requirements from open demand, with draft purchase orders grouped by vendor.
Automated production scheduling across machines and labor, re-optimized as priorities change.
Shop-floor kiosks where operators clock labor, pick material and record progress on each operation.
Live inventory by location, with lot and certification tracking.
Receiving against purchase orders, shipments against sales orders, and packing documents.
Live job costs from actual labor, machine time and material, compared with estimates.
Live production, inventory, quality and shop-floor reports.

current.service_desc:
Fulcrum is a cloud manufacturing operations system for small and mid-sized discrete manufacturers, including CNC machine shops, sheet metal fabricators, and aerospace and defense suppliers. It combines ERP, MRP and manufacturing execution in one web application, from quoting and planning through scheduling, shop-floor tracking, quality, shipping and invoicing.

Archie, the AI built into Fulcrum, answers questions about a customer's live shop data, takes actions on it, and builds custom pages and tools. Customers can also connect their own AI assistants to the same data tools through the Fulcrum MCP server, within each user's permissions. Archie's AI models are hosted in Microsoft Azure Government with the rest of the offering, so prompts to Archie and the shop data it reads stay in Azure Government; a customer's own assistant runs wherever the customer chooses.

Customers reach the service through a web browser, a REST API and MCP.
